smell: Package doc claims invoked-as-root exits 77 (EX_NOPERM, set in cmd/okdctl/main.go) but cmd/okdctl/main.go contains no rejection code; ensureRoot in elevation.go returns errtypes.AuthError which exitCodeFor maps to 5. docs/cli/exit-codes.md correctly documents code 5; the package doc is the single source of drift.
severity_reason: misleading documentation about exit-code contract on a privilege-escalation surface; scripts that branch on 77 will miss real rejections
fix_summary: Edit the package doc in internal/cli/root.go to drop the '77 (EX_NOPERM)' line — invoked-as-root rejection actually surfaces as AuthError -> 5, matching docs/cli/exit-codes.md. If 77 is desired (sysexits-style), introduce a sentinel and add to exitCodeFor; otherwise just remove the false claim.
rule_source: CLAUDE.md §code-comments — package doc must accurately describe invariants
repo-counter-example: docs/cli/exit-codes.md correctly documents the AuthError -> 5 mapping
internal/cli/elevation.go:88-92 returns AuthError, internal/cli/root.go:192-195 maps AuthError to 5
must_preserve: the rest of the exit-code taxonomy doc which is correct

smell: Documented StepDef shape is missing ReRunSafe (mandatory — BuildSteps panics if unset), AlreadyDone (consulted before Exec), and OnStart hook. Recent commit 1e505e9 'require ReRunSafe declaration on every StepDef' added the field; doc was not regenerated.
evidence:
docs: type StepDef struct { ID, Name, Desc, Exec, SkipWhen, SkipReason, NonFatal, OnError }
actual (internal/distribution/step.go:211-223): adds ReRunSafe, AlreadyDone, OnStart
severity_reason: docs are the canonical reference for adding steps; ReRunSafe is now mandatory and BuildSteps panics on omission — readers following stale doc hit a runtime panic
fix_summary: Update the StepDef code block in docs/architecture/phases.md to mirror the canonical struct in internal/distribution/step.go (add ReRunSafe, AlreadyDone, OnStart). Add a short note that ReRunSafe is mandatory — BuildSteps panics with 'must declare ReRunSafe' when unset.
rule_source: CLAUDE.md §code-comments — docs must not contradict code
commit 1e505e9 'refactor(distribution): require ReRunSafe declaration on every StepDef'
must_preserve: the prose explanation of why phases are data-driven

actual (internal/distribution/okd/phase/paths.go:129-134): adds Recorder distribution.MetricsRecorder
fix_summary: Add Recorder field to the documented BasePhase code block and a one-line note explaining its role (per-step + overall observation sink, defaults to nopMetricsRecorder via WithRecorder).
rule_source: CLAUDE.md §code-comments — docs must not contradict code

smell: 'Adding a new step' instructions list NonFatal and SkipWhen but never mention ReRunSafe, which BuildSteps requires. A reader following these steps verbatim will hit 'BuildSteps: step <id> must declare ReRunSafe (ReRunSafeYes or ReRunSafeNo)' panic at first run.
evidence:
docs step 4: 'Set NonFatal: true only if the step is genuinely optional'
actual: BuildSteps panics if ReRunSafe == ReRunSafeUnset
severity_reason: adoption-blocking — the documented procedure produces a runtime panic at first invocation
fix_summary: Add a step '0' or first-class step explaining ReRunSafe: every StepDef must set ReRunSafeYes (idempotent across re-runs — preferred default) or ReRunSafeNo (combined with AlreadyDone for resume safety). Note the panic in BuildSteps.

rule_source: CLAUDE.md §code-comments — docs must not contradict code

fix_summary: Add DecodeSettings to the documented interface block and a one-line description: 'converts the flat settings map into a typed struct'.

fix_summary: Replace 'kubeconfig' with 'project root' (and note the AddonConfig is the per-addon settings slice). Kubeconfig is reached transitively via env.Exec, not directly from Environment.

smell: docs cites `flux.go:223-231` for DefaultSettings — actual range is 230-238 (off by 7). Cites `flux.go:22-25` for duration constants — actual is 23-26. Stale anchors rot every refactor; a structural reference (function name, no line numbers) is more durable.
evidence:
docs/addons/flux.md:30-31
flux.go DefaultSettings actually 230-238; duration constants 23-26
fix_summary: Drop line numbers; cite by symbol (`Flux.DefaultSettings` and `defaultControllerTimeout/defaultGitRepoSyncTimeout`). Or run a CI check that grep's the doc anchors against the source.
rule_source: Go proverb: clear is better than clever (line numbers are clever, names are clear)
